sources.locator: Title search: GCM 进入 TLS 与 NIST 标准化

statement.zh: **事件**：GCM 进入 TLS 与 NIST 标准化（GCM Standardized in TLS and by NIST）。把 GCM 带进 TLS 的文档是 RFC 5288：§1「This document describes the use of AES [AES] in Galois Counter Mode (GCM) [GCM] (AES-GCM) with various key exchange mechanisms as a cipher suite for TLS.」并说明它是一次性提供机密性与来源认证的 AEAD——「AES-GCM is an authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) cipher (as defined in TLS 1.2 [RFC5246]) providing both confidentiality and data origin authentication.」§3 列出十二个套件常量（从 TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 到 DH_anon 变体），并规定 nonce 长度为 12 字节、由 4 字节 salt 加 8 字节显式部分组成；基于椭圆曲线的套件不在本文范围内，§1 说明它们「are defined in a separate document [RFC5289]」。
statement.en: **Event**: GCM Standardized in TLS and by NIST.It is registered under authentication and AEAD, dated 2004.

statement.zh: 性能是明写的推动力：§1 指出「AES-GCM is not only efficient and secure, but hardware implementations can achieve high speeds with low cost and low latency, because the mode can be pipelined.」§1 只记录该模式已被指定用于 IPsec ESP 与 802.1AE MAC 安全（原句见历史节），未给出复用硬件这类理由。§4 则解释为何必须先升级到 TLS 1.2：这些套件「make use of the authenticated encryption with additional data defined in TLS 1.2」，因此「They MUST NOT be negotiated in older versions of TLS.」。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in authentication and AEAD, not because of its name.

statement.zh: NIST 侧的标准化文本是 SP 800-38D（2007 年 11 月），标题即「Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) and GMAC」，把 GCM 作为分组密码工作模式纳入建议；该文本只定义模式本身，不涉及 TLS 套件命名。其参考文献[7] 给出更早的设计来源：「D.McGrew and J.Viega.The Security and Performance of the Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) of Operation.Proceedings of INDOCRYPT '04, Springer-Verlag, 2004.」。

statement.zh: GCM 的失效条件被写进规范。§6.1 直接说「AES-GCM security requires that the counter is never reused.」§3 把这条转成逐记录要求：「Each value of the nonce_explicit MUST be distinct for each distinct invocation of the GCM encrypt function for any fixed key.」并警告「Failure to meet this uniqueness requirement can significantly degrade security.」§4 还留了一个兼容性陷阱：TLS 没有让客户端表达`支持 1.2 但不接受更早版本`的办法，于是「a non-compliant server might potentially negotiate TLS 1.1 or earlier and select one of the cipher suites in this document」，规范要求客户端检出版本不符并回「illegal_parameter」致命告警。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: 时间线经核证更正：该条目目库存原写 `SP 800-38D(2007)`并把事件标在 2004 年，但 GCM 进入 TLS 是 RFC 5288（J.Salowey、A.Choudhury、D.McGrew，Cisco Systems，2008 年 8 月，Standards Track），NIST 标准化是 SP 800-38D（2007 年 11 月）；2004 只是 SP 800-38D 参考文献所引的 McGrew 与 Viega 设计论文（见用途节），不是任一标准文本本身。§1 还记录该模式的适用面早于 TLS：「AES-GCM has been specified as a mode that can be used with IPsec ESP [RFC4106] and 802.1AE Media Access Control (MAC) Security [IEEE8021AE].」。
statement.en: Registered period: Web & Protocol Era.The registered year is 2004; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
